A termination notice must state the cause. No-fault terminations require 30 or 60 days' written notice per Civ. Code 1946.1 that states the right to relocation assistance and the right of offer to renew. Relocation assistance is paid by direct payment or rent waiver, regardless of tenant income or length of tenancy. Landlords must give a curable-violation notice before a 3-day notice to quit for curable at-fault causes. Substantial remodel or demolition requires permits to be posted, secured, and served with the notice. Landlords must give tenants a written notice of the ordinance with the SDHC Tenant Protection Guide. Tenants have a right of offer for 5 years after a no-fault eviction (not for withdrawal from the rental market). Buyout agreements must meet disclosure and form requirements or are void. Retaliation is banned. Notice to SDHC within 3 business days is required but not yet in effect until 30 days after the SDHC portal is announced.",
